Diese pharaonischen Ruinen in der Nähe des Heiligen Sees stellen ein unterirdisches Bauwerk dar, das von Taharqa, dem nubischen König der 25. Dynastie, errichtet wurde.
A Szent Tó közelében található fáraókori romok egy földalatti építményt képviselnek, amelyet Taharka, a 25. dinasztia núbiai királya építtetett.
Situate lângă Lacul Sacru, aceste ruine faraonice reprezintă un edificiu subteran construit de regele nubian Taharqa din a 25-a Dinastie.
Located near the Sacred Lake, these pharaonic ruins represent a subterranean edifice built by the 25th Dynasty Nubian king Taharqa.

historical

In 1903, archaeologists excavating this ancient courtyard discovered a massive pit containing thousands of buried pharaonic statues and bronze artifacts.
Port of the Temple
historical

historical

historical

historical

historical

This vast archaeological courtyard is famous for its Bubastite Portal, featuring reliefs commemorating the military campaigns of the 22nd Dynasty pharaoh Shoshenq I.
